e.title: Reinsurance Contracts Repository
e.summary: SEC 申报公开再保合同大型语料（+HF 分类数据集）：再保合同 NLP 的数据基础
e.body: Reinsurance Contracts Repository 是从 SEC 申报中提取的公开再保险合同大型语料：含分类标注，数据集同时发布在 HF（andreaaltomani/reinsurance-contracts-classification）。对 RIAA：再保合同文档的 NLP/LLM 数据基础（合同分类、条款抽取、RAG）。与 [[finixdocbench]]（文档解析基准）、保险文档 agent、[[claimpilot-harness]] 互补。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[ai-tools-for-actuaries]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：SEC 申报公开再保合同语料+分类（HF 数据集 andreaaltomani/reinsurance-contracts-classification）
e.summary_en: Large corpus of public reinsurance contracts from SEC filings (+HF classification dataset): the data foundation for reinsurance-contract NLP
e.summary_hk: SEC 申報公開再保合同大型語料（+HF 分類數據集）：再保合同 NLP 的數據基礎
e.body_en: Reinsurance Contracts Repository is a large corpus of publicly available reinsurance contracts extracted from SEC filings: with classification labels, and the dataset also published on HF (andreaaltomani/reinsurance-contracts-classification). For RIAA: the NLP/LLM data foundation for reinsurance-contract documents (contract classification, clause extraction, RAG). Complements [[finixdocbench]] (document-parsing benchmark), insurance document agents (document agents) and [[claimpilot-harness]]. Related: [[reinsurance]], [[ai-tools-for-actuaries]].
e.body_hk: Reinsurance Contracts Repository 是從 SEC 申報中提取的公開再保險合同大型語料：含分類標註，數據集同時發佈在 HF（andreaaltomani/reinsurance-contracts-classification）。對 RIAA：再保合同文檔的 NLP/LLM 數據基礎（合同分類、條款抽取、RAG）。與 [[finixdocbench]]（文檔解析基準）、保險文檔 agent、[[claimpilot-harness]] 互補。關聯 [[reinsurance]]、[[ai-tools-for-actuaries]]。
